utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I’m just back from the shops—has there been any new word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not that I’ve heard yet, Ira. I’d like a clear time and place before I set anything aside.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Same here—I don’t want to start gathering things until we know where and when to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I only caught the gist—this repair drive is still happening this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, still on for this weekend. Bring anything that needs a simple fix, and I’ll confirm the exact time if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—I'll dig around for a couple things and keep an eye out for the final time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hey Pia, I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but can you confirm the details before I start telling anyone?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d be glad to, but let me double-check the time, location, and what items they’ll actually accept before you spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Pia—please let me know once you’ve confirmed it, especially the time and what they’re accepting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Cleo—remind me, is the repair drive still this weekend? I meant to help, but you know how my calendar gets away from me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still this weekend—Saturday morning at the community room. I’m keeping the supply list, so if you can bring tape or spare batteries, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning, community room—got it, Cleo. I’ll bring tape and some spare batteries, and I’ll write it down before it slips away again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah, before we get started, can you remind me which repairs the drive is focusing on and who’s already offered to help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I’m a bit behind on the latest list. I think it’s mainly small home fixes and cleanup repairs, but I don’t want to guess who’s signed up yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—let’s not assume, then. Could you check the latest signup sheet or point me to whoever’s keeping it so we know exactly what’s needed and who’s helping?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late as usual—what have I missed about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—you’re right on time for the useful part. We’re matching folks who can fix bikes, lamps, and small appliances with neighbors bringing things by, and I was hoping you could help spread the word to your crew.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, I can text the group and post it on the block chat—what time and place should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you’re organizing the repair drive—how can I pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—could you help set up tables Saturday morning and maybe bring any spare screwdrivers or extension cords you can lend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can be there Saturday morning to help set up, and I’ll bring the spare screwdrivers and extension cords I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye, I’m starting a location list for the repair drive so nothing gets misplaced. Do you already know where people are dropping off tools and parts?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but I can ask around at school pickup today and send you the spots people mention.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye—if you can send me each spot with the person’s name and what they’re dropping off, I’ll start the list and keep it updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Quinn, have you heard the latest about the repair drive? I was just about to ask who’s bringing what, because folks are already starting to organize.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I hadn’t heard the full list yet, Tess, but I can start spreading the word right away—tell me what’s needed and I’ll nudge the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Quinn—can you tell folks we still need spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and anyone handy with bicycles or small appliances?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, what repairs are we collecting for first, and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting the details, but I think we should start with the most urgent home fixes first. I don’t know the full helper list yet—who have you heard is signed up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So far I’ve heard Tomas can do Saturday morning and Lila has tools, but that’s it. Can you get me the urgent repair list by tonight so we know who to call?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Nell, I’ve been hearing folks talk about the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Vik — I’m still catching up myself, but I heard they’re gathering broken small appliances and tools this weekend. I can ask around and let you know what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell—if you hear the confirmed time and drop-off spot, let me know and I’ll pass it along to the others.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—do you have a moment to talk through what still needs organizing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I have a few minutes. I can help sort through what’s left, though I may need to keep things simple today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, we’ll keep it simple—let’s just pick the top two things that still need owners and not worry about the whole list today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive yet? I’m trying to get the word around before folks start tossing things that could be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't heard the details yet, Tess. If you tell me the date, time, and what kinds of items you’re taking, I can help spread the word in an orderly way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, Eli—it's this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community room, and they’re taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and mending projects, but no big electronics or anything hazardous.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late catching up—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, no worries—I’m still getting the latest list together, so I’m not sure what’s left yet. Once I hear, I’ll pass the plan around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, thanks—just put me wherever you need an extra pair of hands once the list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Uli, I heard a little about the repair drive, but I’m still not sure how it works. What are you hoping neighbors will bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly small things people can spare—tools, screws, old lamps, maybe a steady pair of hands. I’m hoping we can fix what’s fixable without making anyone feel they have to give more than they can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds thoughtful, Uli. I could bring a small box of spare screws and sit with someone who needs help sorting things out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I saw something about the repair drive but only skimmed it—what’s the main thing you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Main thing is keeping track of where the repair kits and sign-up sheets end up, so I could use help checking the porch table and community room before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can swing by and check the porch table and community room before it starts, then let you know where everything is.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I was thinking the repair drive could be a great chance to bring a few different groups together—maybe the garden crew, the parents’ chat, and some of the bike folks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds promising, Jules—before we ask anyone, can we pin down what kind of repairs we’re offering and which day we’re aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good point—let’s keep it focused to bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends, and maybe aim for Saturday morning if the community room is free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—sorry, I might be a little behind. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Noah — we still need someone to confirm the tool table, check in with the volunteer fixers, and put up a few reminder flyers. If you can take one of those, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can handle the reminder flyers—I'll put a few up around the block this afternoon, unless the plan changed and I missed it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Gus, I’m just catching up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, we’re still gathering tools and lining up a few volunteers, but it’s coming together. I’m bringing my drill set and some clamps, so we should be in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Gus—while I’m out running errands, I’ll ask around for extra tools or anyone who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. We mostly need extension cords, a folding table, and someone to help label drop-off items Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring two extension cords and a folding table, and I’ll be there Saturday morning to help label items.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we pick a date, do we know where people will drop things off and who’s keeping track of the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s pin that down first: can the community room handle drop-offs, and do you know who’s willing to keep the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check with the building office about the community room, but I’d feel better if we had two people sharing the repair list so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to make sure you get the details and invite a few folks nearby too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please send me the details, Quinn—I can check what supplies we have and invite a few neighbors nearby.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Cleo — I’ll send you the details now and start nudging a few neighbors nearby so we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—do we know if it’s happening before or after school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh goodness, I think it’s meant to be after pickup, but let me double-check so I don’t steer you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—that would help a lot. If it’s after pickup, I can probably swing by with the kids for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m glad I caught you—I'm starting to organize the repair drive and would love your thoughts on what folks on the block need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh hi Rosa, that sounds wonderful—I’m still getting caught up through what others mention, but I’ve heard folks could really use help with small appliance fixes and maybe bike repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s really helpful, Nell—small appliances and bike repairs sound like a great starting point. I’ll ask around for anyone with those skills and see about setting up a sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, I’m starting a location list for the repair drive—where should I mark the drop-off spot and any pickup points?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—mark the main drop-off at the community center front porch, and let’s add pickup points at Maple Court and the laundromat bulletin board for now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll mark the community center front porch as the main drop-off, with pickup points at Maple Court and the laundromat bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I’m a little out of the loop on the repair drive—what’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard they’re collecting broken small appliances and tools at the community room this Saturday morning, and I’m already telling folks on the block to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to know—Saturday morning at the community room, got it. I’ll pass that along too, but I’ll mention I heard it second-hand from you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, I’m just starting a supply list for the repair drive—do you already know what tools or materials people need most?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I don’t want to guess. I can ask a couple folks one-on-one today and tell you what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, thanks Rey—if you can note any repeat requests, I’ll start the list with those first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Hana, remind me—are we collecting tools for the repair drive today, or am I already mixing that up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Oren — I think it is today, but let me double-check the notice before we start telling folks. Was it tools only, or tools plus small parts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it was tools plus small parts, but don’t trust my memory until you’ve checked the notice.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I’m trying to work around school pickup times—when are you thinking of holding the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I haven’t pinned it down yet. I was thinking maybe Saturday late morning, unless that clashes with pickup or family stuff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday late morning should work for us—pickup won’t be an issue then. If you land on a time, I can help spread the word to other parents.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, I’ve got a few spare tools I can bring for the repair drive if that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Gus. Thank you—I’ll make sure they’re put to good use.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring a drill, socket set, and a couple clamps by early that morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces while I’m out—how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s moving, but I need specifics—do you have tools to lend, or can you take a shift at the table?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take a table shift Saturday morning, and I’ve got a spare socket set and a couple screwdrivers I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Vik. If we’re doing this repair drive, I’d like us to settle the date, the drop-off spot, and who’s minding the sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good morning, Eli — yes, let’s pin those down now: date, drop-off spot, and who handles sign-in. Once we settle it, I’ll make sure everyone hears the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make it Saturday the 15th, use the community hall porch for drop-off, and I can mind the sign-in sheet from nine to noon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Sam, bless you—first thing is spreading the word, because half the block still thinks it’s just for bikes and not lamps, toasters, and all those little fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help clear that up—I’ll put the word out that it’s for lamps, toasters, bikes, and all those small repairs too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m jumping in late—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and where can I help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries. We’re collecting broken lamps, chairs, and small appliances Saturday at 10 by the community room—can you help sort drop-offs for the first hour?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes, I can do the first hour sorting drop-offs Saturday at 10 by the community room. I’ll show up a few minutes early so you can point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Bo, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara—thanks. I’m a bit swamped, so first I need a quick list of what’s broken and who can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Bo—I’ll start a quick list today and ask around about tools so we know what we’re working with.
